title: Round-trip drift outcomes
description: The answers an adjudicator may give when round-trip translation QA flags a passage whose back-translation differs from the source. A machine can detect that two readings differ; which one is right is a human call.

source.note: bean bvuk; owner approved the answer set 2026-09-23

codes.label: Real drift
codes.definition: The translation lost or changed the meaning of the source, or used the wrong term; the passage needs correcting.

codes.label: False positive
codes.definition: The two readings say the same thing; the flag was a difference in wording, not in meaning.
